headline: FPIs sell Rs 6,434 crore worth of Indian stocks daily in March; what’s next? - BusinessToday
summary: FPI equity flows into India turned negative again in March and may stay volatile in the near term, Antique Stock Broking said. Heightened geopolitical tensions in West Asia are cited.
why: Foreign portfolio investors are a major source of liquidity for Indian equities, so their flows move the BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty. Outflows often pressure the rupee as well.
why_moved: Foreign portfolio investors have been net sellers of Indian equities in March, with heightened West Asia tensions cited as the source of volatility.
